Q132g_check.q132_statement: Q132(g)'s README (13de3994), 'What the data show': 25 falls in six sessions against 23.5 expected (2 ms in 1000.01 ms over 11,781 kernel boundaries at 800 MHz), 95% interval 16.2-36.9

label: POST HOC (the data existed before A1, 3002edaf; A1's rule was chosen after reading the verifier's Q132(g) check and E173-E175's rings)

DT-N.form: A1-1: a fall is an eligible gap whose next launch reads 0.55-0.62 GHz; eligible = structurally eligible, in scope (A1-3), and the launch before at >= 0.79 GHz, or at >= 0.65 GHz in a clear process (A1-2); expected and band as registered. A rate check: it tests how many falls the gaps allow, not where.

registered_falls_not_counted.why: the launch before read 0.764 GHz, under 0.79, and the process is not clear (3 governor or alarm steps to <= 620 MHz in the run's ring)

oracle.label: POST HOC by construction (the lattice fitted on all of the session's falls)
